target_segments: Adequate bone marrow reserve, defined as absolute neutrophil count at least 1.0 x 10^9/L, hemoglobin at least 8.0 g/dL, and platelets at least 75 x 10^9/L.

text_span: absolute neutrophil count at least 1.0 x 10^9/L
sub_criteria.rationale: The absolute neutrophil count threshold is an independently assessed component of the explicitly defined bone marrow reserve requirement.
The hemoglobin threshold is an independently assessed component of the explicitly defined bone marrow reserve requirement.
The platelet threshold is an independently assessed component of the explicitly defined bone marrow reserve requirement.

output.notes: The three thresholds exhaustively define the broad bone marrow reserve umbrella; no residual pass/fail meaning remains in the wrapper.
